create_cli_option_decorator: use the cli_option decorator to register a new command-line flag with short and long forms
implement_commandlineoption_subclass: subclass CommandLineOption to add a custom CLI flag with an execute classmethod
use_debug_option: use the debug_option flag to set a sacred run into debug mode and suppress warnings
use_loglevel_option: use the loglevel_option to set the logging level for a sacred run by number or name
use_enforce_clean_option: use the enforce_clean_option to fail a run if any version control repository has uncommitted changes
